subject: general
question: Which of the following is an animal hormone?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Insulin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Insulin **was originally produced from cow and pig pancreases. Animal-sourced insulin is manufactured from beef or hog pancreas preparations and has been used to manage diabetes safely for many years.
 
• Insulin is a hormone that regulates many aspects of growth and development by signalling nutritional conditions to grow tissues.
 
• It is most typically connected with glucose metabolism in vertebrates. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Plant hormones** called** cytokinins** induce cell division, or cytokinesis, in plant roots and shoots. They play a role in cell proliferation and differentiation, as well as apical dominance, axillary bud development, and leaf senescence.
 
• **Auxins** are a group of plant hormones (or plant growth regulators) that resemble morphogens.
 
• **Gibberellin (GA)** is a plant hormone that controls a variety of processes such as plant growth, organ development, and environmental responses.
